name: @activepieces/piece-deepgram
description: Deepgram is an AI-powered speech recognition platform that provides real-time transcription, text-to-speech, and audio analysis capabilities.

auth.description: You can obtain your API key from [Deepgram Console](https://console.deepgram.com/).

create_summary.name: create_summary
create_summary.description: Produces a summary of the content from an audio file.

auth.description: You can obtain your API key from [Deepgram Console](https://console.deepgram.com/).

fallbackToTranscript.description: Return full transcript if summary is not available.

aiMetadata.description: Uploads an audio file to Deepgram and returns an AI-generated summary of its spoken content (summarize v2), synchronously. Pick this over Create Transcription when you need a condensed overview rather than the full text; by default it falls back to the full transcript if no summary is available. Re-running re-processes the audio and incurs another billed request, though it creates no persistent resource.

create_transcription_callback.name: create_transcription_callback
create_transcription_callback.description: Creates a transcription using a callback URL.

auth.description: You can obtain your API key from [Deepgram Console](https://console.deepgram.com/).

callbackUrl.description: URL to receive the transcription when ready.

aiMetadata.description: Submits an audio file to Deepgram for asynchronous speech-to-text: the action returns only a request ID immediately, and the finished transcript is delivered later to the callback URL you provide. Pick this for long audio or when a webhook endpoint will consume the result; it does not return the transcript itself. Each run submits a new billed transcription job, so it is not idempotent.

list_projects.name: list_projects
list_projects.description: Retrieves a list of all projects associated with the account.

aiMetadata.description: Fetches all Deepgram projects accessible to the authenticated API key, with no inputs or filters. Use it to discover project IDs before project-scoped operations or to verify account access. Read-only and safe to call repeatedly.

auth.description: You can obtain your API key from [Deepgram Console](https://console.deepgram.com/).

aiMetadata.description: Synthesizes speech from text using a Deepgram Aura voice and saves the result as an audio file in a chosen encoding (mp3 by default). Pick this only for generating spoken audio from text, the inverse of the transcription actions. Each run produces a newly generated, billed audio file, so it is not idempotent.

custom_api_call.name: custom_api_call
custom_api_call.description: Make a custom API call to a specific endpoint

auth.description: You can obtain your API key from [Deepgram Console](https://console.deepgram.com/).

headers.description: Authorization headers are injected automatically from your connection.

auth.description: You can obtain your API key from [Deepgram Console](https://console.deepgram.com/).

response_is_binary.description: Enable for files like PDFs, images, etc.
